name: Zenith — the field planetarium
description: A professional-grade field planetarium that works offline: 8,900 real stars (HYG database), all 88 constellations, the full Messier catalog, Meeus-grade sun/moon/planet positions, an observation planner ranked by sky quality, polar alignment, imaging FOV and pixel-scale calculators, Jupiter's moons, and a red night-vision mode.
